meta.window_note: FenderBrain is documentation-only and captures/triages into the Second Brain Notion database rather than owning household action data itself (see CLAUDE.md). This file is hand-maintained/conversationally populated during a live, human-directed Claude Code session — never by a standing script that queries Notion on its own (see CLAUDE.md's 'No automation code without a separate council decision' rule and this file's own Action Section). A one-time live read of the Second Brain database was performed on 2026-08-17 to seed this snapshot: every currently-open, dated Second Brain item found either already belongs to another repo's own system of record (pm_oraclecmms/Work Tasks Tracker for Chick-fil-A work items, FenderHouse for home-audit follow-ups, youngadults.whc for Prayer/Ministry items) per taxonomy.md's 'not a third system of record' rule, or is a dateless Business Idea backlog entry not suited to a 14-day calendar placement. Rather than duplicate another repo's tracked work here, the three entries below are FenderBrain's own genuinely-unowned open items, drawn from second-brain/open-questions.md.

actions.text: Complete a Second Brain access & data-handling review (Notion workspace access, n8n automation's OAuth/API scopes, Telegram bot's access model, the newer Claude Code Notion connector access, and a retention/deletion policy for captured data)
actions.notes: Flagged by the council's Sentinel seat, 2026-08-10; unresolved. The database co-mingles employer-confidential, personal-financial, and third-party-personal data in one place, so this carries real risk despite having no natural deadline.

actions.notes: Flagged by the council's Realist seat, 2026-08-10; unresolved. Sample data shows scores 0-0.9 across Types with no visible pattern.
